description_en: Deletes a routing algorithm from a logical table
description_zh: 删除逻辑表路由算法配置信息
name: DeleteLogicTableRouteConfig

parameters.help_en: The ID of the logical table. You can call the ListLogicTables (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/data-management-service/latest/listlogictables) operation to query the ID of the logical table
parameters.help_zh: 逻辑库的表ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141875.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: table_id

parameters.help_en: The unique key of the routing algorithm. You can call the ListLogicTableRouteConfig (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/data-management-service/latest/listlogictablerouteconfig) operation to query the unique key
parameters.help_zh: 路由算法唯一键，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/363030.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: route_key

parameters.help_en: The ID of the tenant. You can call the GetUserActiveTenant (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/data-management-service/latest/getuseractivetenant) operation to query the tenant ID
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: tid

ErrorMessage.example: RouteKey is mandatory for this action.
